description: This file defines the class `FormatWithProject` which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. It provides functionality to format a value (likely a project ID) into the project name by accessing the project service and DAO.

classes.name: FormatWithProject
classes.description: A class implementing `ValueFormatter` to convert project IDs into project names using project services.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the project name for a given project ID if the project exists, otherwise null.
